_meta.use: QA-08 (D54, RC PRIV-01): content that must never appear in an analytics payload, a Sentry event or a log line. qa/app/privacy.test.ts feeds every string into the analytics wrappers and greps what the real PostHog SDK puts on the wire. Free text carries the FIXTURE- prefix so a hit is easy to find; names and emails are the personas' own (qa/fixtures/personas.json).
_meta.add: Add a string when a new kind of content ships (a new free-text field, a new id that names a person). Keep each one distinctive (a plain word like 'yes' would also match JSON keys) and realistic: real invite tokens are mixed-case base64url (invites_v2.sql), real names are capitalised. A lowercase-hyphen string would pass the catalogue's slug check (badge ids), which is a shape check, not a content check.
